summary: Iteration 8 — verified the three defect fixes from iteration 7 and re-ran full regression. All 134 existing tests still pass (3 skipped), and a new /app/backend/tests/test_iteration8_verify.py adds 8 targeted tests that all pass. FIX 1+2 (duplicate rec guard): second POST /recommend-mtd → 409 with body containing 'A MTD recommendation is already pending on this case'; second /recommend-package → 409; /recommendations shows exactly ONE PENDING row per case+type; types are INDEPENDENT (an MTD PENDING does not block a PACKAGE_UPGRADE PENDING on the same case, verified 200); after REJECT a NEW rec of the same type is allowed (200); after APPROVE a third rec of the same type is still blocked (409 'already approved'). FIX 3 (duplicate payment): two consecutive /payments/upgrade-checkout for the same (client, target package) return the SAME session_id with reused:true; two consecutive /payments/offer-checkout for the same offer_id return the SAME session_id with reused:true; polling /payments/status/{sid} 5× against an unpaid session does not apply any upgrade and does not mutate service state. Test-expectation changes in iteration 7 (test_iteration7_audit::test_two_concurrent_upgrade_sessions_created flipped to assert reuse, test_taxsimba_phase1b::test_recommend_mtd accepts 200 OR 409) match the fixed behaviour and are NOT masking anything — the shared seeded case in test_taxsimba_phase1b legitimately hits the new guard on later parametrized runs, and iteration7_audit now correctly asserts the positive fixed contract (session_id equal, reused==True). Frontend smoke: all four role journeys reachable and rendering — client dashboard, client my-return, accountant work board, admin all-cases, admin recommendations, super admin operations control centre. Screenshots captured under /app/test_reports/screens_it8/. Recommendations admin screen visibly shows one PENDING + one REJECTED for the same case (SA-1352) — proves the 'REJECTED unblocks new rec' pathway end-to-end — and one MTD PENDING + one PACKAGE PENDING on SA-1350 (types independent). No duplicate PENDING rows for the same case+type anywhere in the visible list.

pass_fail_matrix.1_sa_lifecycle_all_four_roles: PASS — client/accountant/admin/superadmin login and land on their correct workspaces; SA case seeded and visible; workflow stage-skip attempts blocked (400/409/422) by tests in test_iteration7_audit::TestWorkflowStageSkip.
pass_fail_matrix.2_permissions_and_privacy: PASS — accountant 403 on /users, /payments, /my-payments, /my-services, /overview, /recommendations; accountant case detail scrub confirmed (no email/phone/utr/address/client_user_id/password_hash/session_id); cross-accountant case IDOR blocked; deactivated user's existing token rejected 401 and re-login 401.
pass_fail_matrix.3_secure_messaging_scope: PASS carried-over from iteration 6 (no code touched in this fix; regression test_taxsimba_phase1.py suite still green).
pass_fail_matrix.4_sa_packages_upgrade_only: PASS — downgrade 400, equal package 400, ELITE upgrade payable session created with correct amount (£100 diff verified against packages seed), history intact; late-stage package-change lock still enforced on READY_FOR_SUBMISSION cases.
pass_fail_matrix.5_multi_service_one_login_one_client_id: PASS — /api/my-services returns single client_ref with multiple services; MTD activation reuses client_id (regression covered).
pass_fail_matrix.6_mtd_visibility_and_duplicate_guard: PASS — MTD only visible after admin approves the recommendation; duplicate MTD recommendation blocked 409; NO Explore Services area (grep confirms zero hits in /app/frontend/src, carry-over).
pass_fail_matrix.7_payments_success_cancel_failure_duplic: PASS — cancel URL /payment/cancel changes nothing (session left open, then reused on retry); duplicate-payment guard verified for both upgrade + offer flows via reused=true; status polling idempotent. Live Stripe 4242 test-card success flow was NOT rerun this iteration because iteration 6 already exercised it and the fulfilment idempotency is now doubly guarded (per-session + business-key), covered by unit tests in test_iteration8_verify.
pass_fail_matrix.9_workflow_integrity_no_stage_skip: PASS — three probed skip attempts (submit-for-admin-review from ASSIGNED, client-approve before admin approval, record-submission before READY) all rejected 400/409/422.
pass_fail_matrix.10_deadlines_visibility: PASS — admin all-cases screen renders DEADLINE column with SA-1352 03 Sept 2026 etc; carry-over from iteration 6, not regressed.
pass_fail_matrix.11_backend_and_frontend_rbac_direct_url_: PASS — direct API hits to admin-only paths as accountant return 401/403 (parametrized test).

critical_code_review_comments: phase1b._inflight correctly retrieves the Stripe session and expires-out stale rows (status!='open') before creating a new one — the 'cancelled/expired sessions permanently blocking a client' concern is NOT reproducible; polling status on an unpaid session and then re-hitting checkout returns a fresh session id once the previous is no longer open.

_fulfil business-key idempotency now covers both SA_UPGRADE (package already applied → mark duplicate) and SERVICE_ACTIVATION (offer already PAID or service already ACTIVE at that package → mark duplicate). Safe against Stripe webhook retries AND against a second session for the same target.

Carry-over risks unchanged and NOT addressed this iteration (as expected): CORS_ORIGINS='*' with cookie auth, no login brute-force lockout on /api/auth/login, phase1b.py = 807 lines and server.py > 1100 lines still exceed the recommended 700-line split threshold.

Minor: 409 detail string 'A MTD recommendation is already pending on this case' hard-codes the lower-cased status ('pending'/'approved'). Acceptable but consider externalising the messages if translations are on the roadmap.

success_rate.backend: 100% (134 regression + 8 new verify tests all pass; 3 legacy skips unchanged)
success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — all four role journey screens rendered without console errors

seed_data_creation: test_iteration8_verify creates ~7 fresh TEST_it8_* CLIENT users, each with a SA case + assigned to accountant.a. These clients appear on the admin Recommendations list. Not destructive to seeded Client A / Client B state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three defect fixes from iteration 7 are verified green. Do NOT rely on Client A/B for fresh recommendation or upgrade tests — reuse the _make_fresh_case pattern in test_iteration8_verify. Live Stripe 4242 flow was not rerun this iteration; if requested, use a fresh client on SMART and confirm exactly one package_history entry after webhook fulfilment.
rca of the issue: All three iteration-7 defects were RCA'd in iteration_7.json and fixed exactly at those points: phase1b._create_recommendation now short-circuits on any PENDING/APPROVED same-type rec; phase1b._inflight is invoked before creating a new Stripe checkout for both SA_UPGRADE (keyed on client_id+kind+new_package) and SERVICE_ACTIVATION (keyed on offer_id+kind), and expires stale non-open sessions in-place so a cancelled Checkout never permanently blocks the client; phase1b._fulfil adds business-key idempotency (package-already-applied OR offer-already-PAID OR service-already-ACTIVE-at-target) marking the transaction fulfilled+duplicate. No regressions detected.
